Hon'ble Shri Justice Ravindra Kumar Agrawal Order on Board 09-05-2025
1.
Pursuant to the order dated 07-04-2025 the victim appeared through virtual mode from DLSA Dhamtari and submitted that she has no objection in granting bail to the applicant.
Her submission is taken on record.
2. Heard on the application filed under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
This is first bail application before this Court filed by the applicant for grant of regular bail.

The applicant has been arrested on 27-11-2024 in connection with Crime No.16/2023 registered at P.S. -
Sihawa, District - Dhamtari, Chhattisgarh for the offence under Section 137(2), 87, 64(2)(m) of BNS (363, 366, 376(2)(n) of IPC Old Act) and Section 6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act (as per charge framed).

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. The case of prosecution is that, on 20-01-2023 the father of the victim lodged a missing report that his minor daughter is missing since 05-01-2023 and her whereabouts could not be traced out.
The FIR under Section 137(2) of BNS/363 of the IPC was registered and police started investigation.

During the investigation the victim was recovered on 27-11-2024 from the house of the applicant and after recording her statement other offences under Section 64(2)(m) of BNS/376(2)(n) of the IPC and 87 of BNS/366 of the IPC Section 6 of POCSO Act have been added and the applicant has been arrested on 27-11-2024 and charge sheet has been filed.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the victim was major on the date of incident and she was having love affair with the applicant and eloped with him on her own will.
Both of them had married and resided together and out of their wedlock a male child has also borne.
The applicant is in jail since 27-11-2024 and final adjudication of the case will take its own time.

Therefore, the applicant may be enlarged on bail.
5.
On the other hand, learned counsel for the State/non-applicant opposes the bail application.

6. Considering the submissions made by learned counsel for the applicant, considering the nature of allegation and material collected during the investigation, further considering the material with respect to the age of victim and her statement recorded under Section 183 of BNSS, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
7. Consequently, this application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of BNSS, 2023 for grant of regular bail is hereby allowed.

It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- with one surety in the like sum to the satisfaction of the concerned trial Court, on the following conditions :-
(i) He shall not, directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him/her from disclosing such facts to the Court ;
(ii) He shall not act, in any manner, which will be prejudicial to fair and expeditious trial; and (iii) He shall appear before the trial Court on each and every date given to him by the said Court till disposal of the trial unless his personal presence is exempted by the trial Court.
Sd/-
